description: Create a new ABAP Metadata Extension (DDLX) in SAP system. Creates the metadata extension object in initial state.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

master_language.description: Optional master/original language for the created object (e.g. "EN", "DE", "ZH"). Defaults to the session language (SAP_LANGUAGE) or EN.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task

name: CreateMetadataExtension
